_note: Missing-content patch for design/marketing/CAD Drafting.dc.html. The canonical seeds cover hero/headings/faqs/stats/steps/use_cases; this patch adds the breadcrumb copy, the 'What you can order' deliverables (value_props — icon key also selects the unit its price is formatted in from /api/v1/catalog/pricing/drafting/), the work gallery (carousel — caption = tag, name = image-slot placeholder), the specialist cards (case_cards — location = role, stat1 = rating), and the three pricing cards (personas — kicker = label, title = unit caption, cta_label = MOST POPULAR badge; the figures themselves come from the drafting pricing config, never from copy). The route change is here too: design/app/Order Render.dc.html and Order Drafting.dc.html are now redirects into the unified quiz, so every CTA and use-case card on this page points at /get-started?intent=drafting instead of /order/drafting. The steps and FAQ that described escrow releases are restored to the current design, which has the client paying the specialist directly. The three pricing personas carry group 'pricing' and their design price in cta_href: the hero's ?svc= variants live on this same scope as personas too (seeds/patches/cad-drafting-variants.json, group 'service-variant'), so the pricing section selects its own group rather than every persona on the page.
